summary: First Mining Gold Corp., a TSX/OTCQX/Frankfurt-listed Canadian gold developer, filed a 6-K on September 17, 2026, attaching a news release and term sheet announcing a bought-deal offering of common shares. The company entered an underwriting agreement with Haywood Securities, ATB Cormark Capital Markets and National Bank Financial as co-lead underwriters and joint bookrunners to sell 59,530,000 common shares at $0.84 each for gross proceeds of approximately $50,005,200, plus a 15% over-allotment option exercisable for 30 days. Proceeds fund the Springpole and Duparquet gold projects plus general working capital. The offering is conducted under a base shelf prospectus dated February 23, 2026, via prospectus supplement in each Canadian province and territory excluding Quebec, with possible private placements in the United States and offshore where exempt. Closing is expected on or about September 24, 2026, subject to customary conditions including TSX approval. This is a routine shelf takedown rather than a special situation; investors watch TSX clearance, subscription demand, final pricing and any over-allotment exercise ahead of the September 24 close.
